name: forge
description: Fast, scope-aware agent workflows with proportional verification, focused plans, durable Canonical Specs, and quality-checked Visual Docs for briefs, plans, specs, and projects.

interface.shortDescription: Fast scoped work, focused plans, and readable Visual Docs.
interface.longDescription: Forge matches process and verification to the work. Clear local changes run through a lightweight Quick path; new logic and behavioral fixes use focused TDD; complex work uses plans centered on outcomes, dependencies, interfaces, and evidence. Durable contract changes remain governed by semantic Canonical Spec Bundles and explicit approved meaning. Visual Docs presents briefs, plans, specs, and project handbooks only on request, then verifies the rendered reading experience and permits source-backed corrections within that request. Forge also includes cross-agent extension authoring, systematic debugging, browser application and website design, and purpose-specific tone skills.
defaultPrompt: Fix this bounded local bug through the Quick route and show fresh focused evidence.
Propose a Spec Delta for this durable policy change before implementation.
Create a plan-only Execution Plan for this complex repository migration without inventing a Canonical Spec.
Create one skill and MCP bundle for Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity.
Use web-app-design to improve this dashboard settings workflow.
Use website-design to create this public product landing page.
Validate this flexible structured Markdown spec without generating HTML.
Create a Visual Doc for this spec only for this review request.
